description: Empirically observed lifecycle profiles for installed hosts. Adapter strategy is chosen per-host from: native-hook | command-shadow | wrapper-delegation | post-update-detection | package-manager-watch | unmanaged-observe.
command_interception_disclaimer: Do not claim any vendor command is intercepted unless empirically demonstrated on that exact runtime/version. All 'intercept' claims below are HYPOTHESES until a test in tests/host-lifecycle/test_host_profiles.py proves them.

hermes.native_customization_restore: vendor prompt: 'restore local customizations?' (best-effort, NOT deterministic)
hermes.intercept_/update: wrapper-delegation (TNF calls hermes update; observes + reconciles)
hermes.resource_fabric_redirect: TNF-managed: managed_frontload + skills index via install-agent-frontload.cjs
hermes.post_maintenance_verification: TNF lifecycle doctor (composed) + fresh-session Turn Zero

claude.tnf_persistent_injection: scripts/install-agent-frontload.cjs ensureClaudeHook() registers hooks/SessionStart -> pnpm run tnf:onboard
claude.native_customization_restore: vendor CLAUDE.md does not exist; Claude uses settings.json for config; not auto-replaced
claude.supported_hooks: SessionStart / PreToolUse / PostToolUse / etc. (native hook registry in settings.json)
claude.intercept_/update: command-shadow: if vendor allows 'claude update' override, route via tnf; otherwise wrapper-delegation
claude.intercept_/doctor: command-shadow: vendor exposes `doctor` subcommand; TNF can compose native + lifecycle
rewrite_paths_on_update: settings.json (hooks may be preserved or reset — vendor-specific)
claude.resource_fabric_redirect: TNF-managed: SessionStart hook reruns pnpm run tnf:onboard on every session
claude.post_maintenance_verification: TNF lifecycle doctor + fresh-session probe (any `claude` invocation runs SessionStart hook)
claude.fresh_session_probe: open `claude` and verify pnpm run tnf:onboard was executed by hook
claude.rollback_capability: TNF-managed backup of settings.json (~/.tnf/backups/agent-frontload/) + vendor-installed backups

kilo.managed_frontload_state: managed-current (kilo has native tnf-startup-gate.md that detects Turn Zero)
kilo.tnf_persistent_injection: scripts/install-agent-frontload.cjs --target kilo writes both AGENTS.md (ignored by kilo) and native tnf-startup-gate.md
kilo.native_update_mechanism: npm-managed (kilo is an npm CLI; `npm update -g kilo` or vendor-supplied self-update)
kilo.native_doctor: no dedicated `kilo doctor`; observe kilo.jsonc + agents/ for drift
kilo.native_customization_restore: vendor-side: kilo merges user kilo.jsonc with vendor defaults
kilo.supported_hooks: kilo plugin system; pre/post command hooks
kilo.intercept_/update: package-manager-watch: kilo is npm-installed; TNF observes via package version change
kilo.intercept_/doctor: unmanaged-observe: no native doctor; lifecycle reconciles kilo.jsonc + agents/ manifest
rewrite_paths_on_update: kilo.jsonc (vendor may reset; user config layered)
kilo.resource_fabric_redirect: TNF-managed: tnf-startup-gate.md native file delegates to pnpm run tnf:onboard
kilo.fresh_session_probe: open kilo and confirm Turn Zero prompt references tnf:onboard

codex.managed_frontload_state: managed-current (BEGIN/END + v2 marker present, plus legacy engineering-principles body preserved)
codex.native_doctor: codex doctor (Diagnose local Codex installation, config, auth, and runtime health)
codex.native_customization_restore: vendor may rewrite AGENTS.md on update; user content is preserved as tail
codex.supported_hooks: PreToolUse / PostToolUse via vendor hooks config
codex.intercept_/update: command-shadow: `codex update` is a vendor subcommand; TNF can wrap via wrapper-delegation
codex.intercept_/doctor: command-shadow: `codex doctor` exposed; TNF composes native + lifecycle
rewrite_paths_on_update: ~/.codex/AGENTS.md (may be vendor-replaced; TNF managed block must be restored)
codex.post_maintenance_verification: TNF lifecycle doctor + fresh-session probe (verify AGENTS.md still contains managed block)

gemini.observed_version: gemini CLI not on PATH; but ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md and ~/GEMINI.md exist as managed frontload files from prior install
gemini.managed_frontload_state: orphan-managed: frontload files exist but no runtime to inject into (binary absent from PATH)
gemini.tnf_persistent_injection: scripts/install-agent-frontload.cjs --target gemini-home,gemini-conf (file-write only; no active runtime)
rewrite_paths_on_update: ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md and ~/GEMINI.md (may be vendor-replaced; TNF block must be restored)
gemini.resource_fabric_redirect: TNF-managed: BEGIN/END blocks in both GEMINI.md files
gemini.post_maintenance_verification: TNF lifecycle doctor + fresh-session probe (validate BEGIN/END blocks still present)
gemini.fresh_session_probe: verify ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md and ~/GEMINI.md still contain TNF-FRONTLOAD:BEGIN block

opencode.native_update_mechanism: npm-managed (opencode is npm-installed; vendor-supplied self-update optional)
opencode.native_customization_restore: vendor may reset opencode.json; user config layered
opencode.supported_hooks: opencode plugin system; pre/post hooks (similar to kilo)
opencode.fresh_session_probe: open opencode and verify Turn Zero prompts reference tnf:onboard

version_discovery: cursor --version (binary on PATH but reports 'no IDE installed'; use 'cursor agent' or 'agent' instead)
cursor.observed_version: no version reported; CLI error suggests IDE-only install
cursor.native_update_mechanism: Cursor IDE auto-update (vendor-controlled, NOT interceptable from CLI)
cursor.native_doctor: no Cursor CLI doctor; doctor happens inside IDE
cursor.native_customization_restore: Cursor overwrites ~/.cursor/ on IDE update; user content is project-scoped
cursor.intercept_/update: post-update-detection: IDE auto-update cannot be intercepted; TNF reconciles on next managed entrypoint
rewrite_paths_on_update: ~/.cursor/ (vendor may rewrite parts; user content layered)
cursor.post_maintenance_verification: TNF lifecycle doctor + manual IDE restart probe
cursor.fresh_session_probe: open project in Cursor IDE; verify AGENTS.md contents

openclaw.observed_version: NOT EXECUTABLE: symlink target /Users/danielgoldberg/.nvm/versions/node/v24.12.0/lib/node_modules/openclaw/openclaw.mjs does not exist (Node v24.12.0 not installed; only v20.20.2 and v22.22.3 present)
openclaw.managed_frontload_target: (no managed frontload target; OpenClaw was not in install-agent-frontload.cjs TARGETS list)
openclaw.reason_absent: Broken symlink + missing Node runtime version. Lifecycle Guardian must detect this drift signal rather than silently treating the symlink as live.

zcode.observed_version: config-only; /Applications/ZCode.app exists; runtime binary on PATH absent (no `zcode` command). State lives in ~/.zcode/cli/{config.json, db/, log/, plugins/, exec/, memories/, artifacts/}
zcode.tnf_persistent_injection: scripts/install-agent-frontload.cjs --target zcode (writes AGENTS.md; runtime injects via ZCode's own mechanism)
zcode.native_update_mechanism: macOS .app update (vendor auto-update or manual download)
zcode.native_doctor: no documented `zcode doctor` CLI; TNF reconciles config.json + plugins/ + AGENTS.md
zcode.native_customization_restore: ZCode AGENTS.md is loaded at session start; TNF-managed BEGIN/END survives
zcode.intercept_/update: post-update-detection: macOS .app cannot be intercepted; lifecycle reconciles on next managed entrypoint
rewrite_paths_on_update: ~/.zcode/AGENTS.md (vendor may replace; TNF block must be restored)
zcode.resource_fabric_redirect: TNF-managed: AGENTS.md BEGIN/END block; ZCode native consumes it
zcode.fresh_session_probe: launch ZCode.app and confirm Turn Zero onboarding triggers
